references.text: The father-in-law urged him to stay and eat and drink, and he remained there for three days. This shows the same pattern of hospitality and insistence on staying.
The father-in-law repeatedly persuaded him to stay longer, demonstrating the same pressure to extend the stay as in verse 7.
Lot insisted that the angels stay with him and spend the night, a similar example of Oriental hospitality where the host urges the guest to remain.
Abraham's servant wanted to leave, but Rebekah's family asked him to stay longer. This shows the same cultural pattern of holding back guests.
